scope: offline retrospective Train-only one-step decode-survivor token progress diagnostic
inputs: native read-only snapshots only; no Gateway events; num_computed_tokens unused
label: output_tokens[k+1] - output_tokens[k] for requests running in both snapshots with output_tokens[k] > 0; zero increments included

features.D: running requests with output_tokens > 0 at k (includes self)
features.Pk: sum physical prompt_tokens/1000 of running requests with output_tokens == 0 at k
features.dt: snapshot sampled_at gap (engine monotonic source clock), known at forecast

models.persistence: lambda = same request's previous valid-interval rate * dt; constant fallback

fit: weighted Poisson MLE, L-BFGS-B, theta>=0, theta0>=0.1ms; weights fixed: seed blocks equal, episodes equal within block, requests equal within episode; no tuning

in_sample_all_blocks.label: in-sample training fit; not a generalisation estimate

limitations: Conditional survivors only: requests finishing inside an interval, new arrivals and prefill-phase requests are excluded and counted; not a global throughput model.
Retrospective Train-only fit under fixed/scheduled budgets; no causal effect of admission actions is identified and no online forecasts were issued.
Intervals within a request/episode are dependent; scores are weighted per request, episode and seed block; no standard errors are claimed.
Poisson 90% interval coverage is a descriptive, uncalibrated dispersion check.
Waiting requests are counts only; their prompts are not visible natively and are not in Pk.
Output counters are engine output tokens; client streaming delay is not modelled.
Each held seed block also has one other-seed block in its prompt/max-output cell only.
